components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis next action for the current lifecycle area.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bounded alternative that does not compete with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{min-height:44px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cbd3d0);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface-strong,#fff);color:var(--text,#17201f);font:650 14px/1 Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{border-color:var(--line-strong,#aebbb7);background:var(--surface,#f8faf9);transform:translateY(-1px)}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#0f766e);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Select Field
components.description: The standard labeled decision control inside Changes.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:7px;color:var(--text,#17201f);font:680 12px/1.4 Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif}.ds-field select{width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cbd3d0);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface,#f8faf9);color:var(--text,#17201f);font:600 14px/1.3 Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif}.ds-field select:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent,#0f766e);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft,#d9eeeb)}

components.name: Registry Row
components.description: A tool, environment, progress item, or transaction record with clear state and supporting detail.
components.css: .ds-registry-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:13px;align-items:start;padding:14px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#cbd3d0);background:transparent;color:var(--text,#17201f);font-family:Aptos,Segoe UI,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-registry-row:hover{background:var(--surface-strong,#fff);transform:translateX(4px)}.ds-registry-row strong,.ds-registry-row small{display:block}.ds-registry-row strong{font-size:14px}.ds-registry-row small{margin-top:4px;color:var(--text-soft,#596562);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}.ds-seal{padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid var(--line,#cbd3d0);border-radius:999px;font:700 12px/1 Cascadia Code,monospace;letter-spacing:.08em}

narrative.overview:
AgentStack Manager is a calm operational lifecycle workspace. Home summarizes readiness, Environments explains what exists across AI apps, IDEs, command-line tools, MCP servers, workspaces, and managed connections, Changes keeps selection, exact review, and the sole client apply action together, and Activity owns installation progress, recovery, history, maintenance, and disclosed diagnostics. Neutral surfaces and restrained teal keep attention on state and the next action rather than exposing internal architecture as navigation.

The system is compact because operators arrive to complete technical work. Flat ledgers, fine dividers, one persistent rail, one installation tracker, and path-free recovery copy provide the product character.
keyCharacteristics: Lifecycle hierarchy keeps detected state, selected intent, pending changes, active installation, and recorded outcomes distinct.
Exactly four primary destinations: Home, Environments, Changes, and Activity.
One continuous selection-to-approval flow and one server-authoritative apply action.
Flat environment, tool, progress, and transaction rows instead of repeated dashboard cards.
Responsive behavior changes topology before type or touch targets shrink.

rules.name: The One Action Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal is reserved for primary action, current selection, focus, and verified state. It is never scattered as decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic Honesty Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red communicate real system state. They do not create visual variety.

rules.name: The Work Surface Rule
rules.body: No separate display typeface enters the product UI. Hierarchy comes from weight, scale, spacing, and structure.

rules.name: The Mono Evidence Rule
rules.body: Monospace is evidence language, not a technical costume.

rules.name: The Topology Before Scale Rule
rules.body: Mobile changes structure first. It does not solve crowding by shrinking labels or touch targets.

rules.name: The Flat Registry Rule
rules.body: Records remain flat and divided. Elevation marks a work surface or a transient layer, never ordinary content.

rules.name: The Two Radius Rule
rules.body: Use 8px for controls and 12px for surfaces. Pills are status artifacts, not a general shape language.

dos: Do present one dominant next action in each workspace area.
Do keep environment visibility observational and route connection mutations through reviewed sync plans.
Do keep every primary control at least 44px high and explicit text at least 12px.
Do show server-reported progress and retained partial results rather than simulated time.
Do keep technical details sanitized and disclosed only when requested.
Do preserve visible focus and text labels at every breakpoint.
donts: Don't add another primary destination for a backend subsystem.
Don't split selection, exact review, and approval into separate screens or modals.
Don't expose filesystem paths, executable commands, arguments, or raw subprocess output in browser messages.
Don't duplicate the same error in a notice, tracker, toast, and activity row.
Don't hide navigation behind icons or shrink touch targets to make mobile fit.
Don't use color, pills, or technical terminology as decoration.
